para_examples.original: I'm planning to price at a healthy level that reflects the quality of what we offer, and I expect stable pricing to serve this market well. I'll keep prices steady as long as the market does.
para_examples.delivered: I intend to set prices at a sound level that matches the quality of what we provide, and I anticipate that consistent pricing will work well for this market. I will hold prices steady for as long as market conditions allow.

para_examples.original: We're pricing for the long term and value, not for a race to the bottom, and we plan to hold steady, premium pricing across the season.
para_examples.delivered: We're setting our prices with lasting value in mind rather than chasing the lowest possible cost, and we intend to keep our premium pricing consistent throughout the season.

para_examples.original: I'll keep steady, quality-focused pricing, and I'd like to see the market settle at levels that let everyone sustain good value. I'm moving my price down a bit to meet the market, and I'm glad to hold there if pricing stays disciplined.
para_examples.delivered: I'll maintain consistent, quality-driven pricing, and I hope the market stabilizes at levels that allow everyone to keep delivering good value. I'm lowering my price somewhat to align with the market, and I'm willing to stay at that level a

para_examples.original: We see the market supporting prices well above commodity levels, and we're moving up to reflect the quality we deliver, staying steady at that level going forward.
para_examples.delivered: Demand in the market sustains pricing well beyond basic commodity rates, so we are raising our prices to match the quality we provide, and we intend to hold at that new level from here on.
